SensorlessCollisionTab.Configure the ZeroErr torque-based colli: Configure the ZeroErr torque-based collision monitor. Changes are applied to the running ROS2 backend and persisted there.
SensorlessCollisionTab.Live observer diagnostics — publish Plot: Live observer diagnostics — publish PlotJuggler topics
SensorlessCollisionTab.100% sensitivity uses calibrated thresho: 100% sensitivity uses calibrated thresholds. Higher values are more sensitive. A longer confirmation duration rejects short spikes but delays stopping. Duration is measured from robot-state timestamps, not callback count.
SensorlessCollisionTab.This is the main sensorless detector. It: This is the main sensorless detector. It compares estimated external torque with the calibrated direction-aware threshold.
SensorlessCollisionTab.Secondary detector — effort and position: Secondary detector — effort and position following error
SensorlessCollisionTab.Optional backup detector. It triggers on: Optional backup detector. It triggers only when measured effort AND position following error exceed their thresholds. Following error is in raw drive counts.

RobotVisualizationTab.Open the robot and workcell visualizatio: Open the robot and workcell visualization on the backend computer. Stopping RViz leaves robot control and MoveIt running.
